Local Teleprompter - third-party runtime components

https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api
Apache License 2.0. See Apache-2.0.txt and notices retained in the library.

Vosk small US English model 0.15
https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
https://ccoreilly.github.io/vosk-browser/models/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.tar.gz
Apache License 2.0. The model is data, not a recording made by this app.

https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Apache License 2.0. Additional font, CMap and decoder licenses are included
in their respective vendor/pdfjs folders.

fflate

MIT License. See fflate-MIT.txt.

UUID, included by Vosk-browser

MIT License. See uuid-MIT.txt.

Capacitor and Capacitor App (Android package)
https://github.com/ionic-team/capacitor
https://github.com/ionic-team/capacitor-plugins
